title: Note Infinite Canvas App
description: Create a new fully-featured S technology app 'note' — an infinite canvas with text blocks, images, tables, math, pencil drawing, fully integrated with hover, selection, hierarchy, window options, VCS persistence, playground dev host, and S program registration.
summary: Implemented the Note infinite-canvas S technology app with text, image, table, math, ink, and group blocks; full playground shell (Canvas + Navigator windows, tools, measures, engagement, hierarchy/catalogue/inspector panels); React NoteCanvas with pan/zoom, selection, marquee, pencil strokes, and KaTeX math renderer interface; platform ComponentKind note + UiNoteHostSurfaceNode; playground renderer bootNotePlay host; app-registry/dev ports/launch.json; S resource 2d.note with program extension and VCS handler. Fixed circular import via note/core/play-ids.ts. Tests pass (test:note); dev:note boots on port 6080.
